body:
Minutes:

- Meeting Opening and Agenda: Mason Freed opened the meeting as chair and reviewed the agenda, which included six issues for discussion ([00:00:01](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.soq14es1kxur)).
- Focus Group V2 Proposal: Jacques Newman presented a proposal for Focus Group V2, which seeks to introduce declarative 2D focus navigation and address nested content handling. Olli Pettay and other participants noted that the proposal covers more than just 2D navigation, including controls that complicate the review ([00:02:49](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.kkmj8aa35fue)). Jacques Newman clarified that the primary objective for stage one is to define the problem of 2D focus navigation and that they are open to adjusting the proposal to focus strictly on that goal. The group agreed to defer the decision for one week to allow participants time to read the explainer ([00:03:47](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.zgq1682f34im)) ([00:08:07](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.b0xp7b8367ic)).
- Selected Content and Select Multiple Proposal: Joey Arhar presented an update to the proposal for making the selected content element work with select multiple, specifically regarding the cloning of options and the potential generation of a wrapper div ([00:09:17](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.qum272y11b5b)). Participants discussed performance concerns, particularly the possibility of excessive Document Object Model (DOM) mutation if thousands of options are selected ([00:12:01](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.1782krx9byr4)) ([00:16:18](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.ou77r1ohrkk)). Joey Arhar and other participants suggested that such performance issues are likely edge cases that can be managed, but agreed to take the discussion back to the issue thread for further review ([00:13:37](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.5mhje5ghnlmz)) ([00:16:18](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.ou77r1ohrkk)).
- Enhancing Import Map Handling: Jens presented a challenge regarding the dynamic insertion of import maps when Content Security Policy (CSP) does not allow "unsafe-inline". The group discussed three potential solutions: an imperative JavaScript API, a new CSP keyword (e.g., "allow-import-maps"), and external import maps ([00:22:44](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.5wbjnc60l97n)) ([00:29:42](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.5x3kv15uf8sp)). Participants raised concerns regarding security implications and the complexity of modifying CSP directives ([00:30:46](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.781y0ydc5nnu)). The group concluded that Jens should bring this discussion to the web security working group to determine the most viable path forward ([00:39:41](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.duwo71td1s0s)) ([00:42:57](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.krrn0n8dibnw)).
- HTML and Canvas Update: Stephen Chenney provided a brief status update on issue #10650, stating that the proposal is not currently ready for discussion because the explainer is not prepared ([00:44:07](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.wdn5li12jxo2)).
- Style Module Imports and Link Elements: Kurt Catti-Schmidt provided an update on issue #10673, informing the group that the proposal has shifted from using shadow root adopted stylesheets to using a link tag for module imports, based on feedback from the CSS working group. Kurt Catti-Schmidt noted that the documentation and pull requests are being updated to reflect this change ([00:44:07](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.wdn5li12jxo2)).
- Location Href Standardization: Anne van Kesteren introduced issue #12800, highlighting a conflict between the current standard and existing browser implementations regarding whether location href navigation should be synchronous or asynchronous. Dominic Farolino and other participants discussed the compatibility risks associated with changing this behavior, as some engines have already implemented it synchronously. The group agreed that further testing is required to understand the impact of these different approaches, and Olli Pettay agreed to assist in facilitating this research ([00:46:13](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.ulmh1yc35s8i)) ([00:51:26](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sW5elgBTRiHjksbsxiYkaQKyFaEvW_UIu5I1cRNjDiQ/edit?userstoinvite=none&resourcekey=0-P4O1edPCgA0Do16hBomwHQ&tab=t.36mrbqsaryvf#heading=h.yvpuysgh0o0t)).
